registered_tools.name: docs_anchor_check
registered_tools.purpose: Derive GitHub-style heading anchors from supplied headings and report fragment references that match none of them.

registered_tools.name: docs_changelog_section_order
registered_tools.purpose: Check one Keep-a-Changelog release block for unknown, duplicate and out-of-order section headings.

registered_tools.name: docs_conventional_groups
registered_tools.purpose: Group supplied conventional-commit subjects into Keep-a-Changelog sections and count breaking changes.

registered_tools.name: docs_api_endpoint_coverage
registered_tools.purpose: Compute the percentage of API endpoints present in the documented endpoint list, with undocumented and unmatched entries.

registered_tools.name: docs_flesch_grade
registered_tools.purpose: Score supplied prose with Flesch-Kincaid grade and reading ease and compare the grade against a limit.

registered_tools.name: docs_stale_doc_age
registered_tools.purpose: Compute document age in days from supplied verified dates and list documents older than the staleness limit.

registered_tools.name: docs_runbook_verified_ratio
registered_tools.purpose: Compute the share of tier-1 runbooks with a recent valid verified date against a target percentage.
